wins.label: Record financing revenues and strong momentum
wins.evidence: financing revenues were a record $2.2 billion for the second quarter and a record $4.4 billion for the first half of the year

wins.label: Alternatives fundraising exceeding targets
wins.evidence: we expect to exceed $50 billion in alternatives fundraising this year

wins.label: M&A and capital markets recovery underway
wins.evidence: we are in the early innings of a capital markets and M&A recovery. And while certain transaction volumes are still well below their 10-year averages, we remain very well positioned

wins.label: Record AWM management fees and assets under supervision
wins.evidence: management and other fees and private banking and lending revenues reached a new record this quarter of $3.2 billion. Our assets under supervision had a record of $2.9 trillion

wins.label: Dividend increase signals confidence
wins.evidence: announced a 9% increase in our quarterly dividend, which underscores our confidence in the durability of our franchise

risks.label: ROE below target despite operational improvements
risks.evidence: 11% ROE in the second quarter, that's not quite the 15% where you want it to be

risks.label: Stress capital buffer increase constrains capital deployment
risks.evidence: Given our higher-than-expected SCB requirement, we plan to moderate buybacks versus the levels of the second quarter

risks.label: Investment Banking volumes still significantly below historical averages
risks.evidence: we're still operating meaningfully below 10-year averages in terms of Investment Banking activity

risks.label: Geopolitical instability and sticky inflation
risks.evidence: there's a high level of geopolitical instability. Elections across the globe could have significant implications for forward policy and inflation is proving to be stickier than many had anticipated

risks.label: AWM ROE still underperforming despite margin improvements
risks.evidence: we've gotten the margin up to 23%, but the ROE is still around 10%
